rows.notes: The cited document is a literature review (Energies 2023, 'A Review of Hydroponics and Conventional Agriculture...'); Section 2.1 states that data were collected from existing literature via keyword searches, and the paper reports no own experiment, survey, measurement or model run. It compiles figures from other sources on land, water, energy and greenhouse gas emissions for hydroponics versus soil cultivation, with tomato and cannabis case tables drawn from the literature. It contains no primary evidence on app-based or smart irrigation scheduling, nor on climate-change adaptation or risk management; the closest material is secondhand statements on water savings in hydroponics.
